name: BT5112C Beard Trimmer
subtitle: Cordless Waterproof Beard Grooming Trimmer
description: Havells BT5112C is a cord and cordless beard trimmer with a rechargeable lithium-ion battery, stainless steel blades, adjustable 0.5–10 mm trimming lengths and an IPX7-rated washable body. It is designed for regular beard and mustache grooming at home or while travelling.
story: Built for regular grooming routines, the BT5112C gives you the option to trim with or without a power connection. Its adjustable length range supports different beard looks, from close stubble to longer styles. The rechargeable battery provides up to around 60 minutes of cordless runtime, while the waterproof body can be rinsed under running water as directed. A compact blue design, LED battery indicator and included grooming accessories make it practical for keeping beard and mustache maintenance organised.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
